title: Going digital: a checklist for your shop
summary: Simple steps to move your shop's records and payments to your phone.

sections.heading: Start with your records
paragraphs: Write every sale and every payment in one place. A digital khata or cash book app can do this.

sections.heading: Accept UPI
paragraphs: Put up a QR code. Read our UPI guide for tips on staying safe.

sections.heading: Know your registrations
paragraphs: Check if you need Udyam registration or GST registration. Read our guides on both.

sections.heading: Keep your data safe
paragraphs: Lock your phone. Never share an OTP or a PIN. Collect only the customer details you need.
